_说明: 主参考图清单。refs 顺序对应提示词里的 image[1]、image[2]…；每张图自动接 canon 和 style_suffix，总长不超 1800 字符。用法：uv run tools/tripo_scene.py --only 13_书生三视图。01~12 是怪化猫版（上游参考，2026-10-23 转向后不再重出），13 起是唐风志异版。
style_suffix: Style: Japanese ukiyo-e anime, 2D cel illustration, entirely flat colours with no gradients and no realistic lighting, every surface shows a visible crumpled washi paper texture, thin dark-indigo coloured outlines (never pure black), bold traditional patterns. No text, no logos, no watermark.
canon: Consistency rules: use only the 13 colours of the palette image (paper cream, coral red, crimson, ochre gold, green, teal, indigo blue, wisteria purple, navy, pale lavender, pink, ink outline, dark wood brown #573F33 for timber frames).

scenes.prompt: Character design turnaround sheet of the Medicine Seller, whose face, make-up, hair and hat must match image[1] and image[2] exactly. Full body, three views side by side on one sheet: front view, side profile, back view, neutral standing pose, same scale, feet on one baseline. Tall slim figure. Tall flat-topped navy cap; long pale lavender hair with pink tips down to the waist; pointed ears; pale lavender skin; narrow gold eyes; thick indigo-blue brow bars each with a red dot; red and blue dotted markings around the eyes; a red vertical line under the lower lip; black fingernails. Layered kimono: teal collar, large coral-red and ochre-gold panels, wisteria-purple sash, covered in hemp-leaf, checker and wave patterns. A big wooden medicine chest with gold fittings on his back, an ornate winged balance scale at his waist, and in his right hand the sword from image[3]. Plain cream washi paper background, no scene. Palette: image[4].

Establishing shot of the inner-palace corridor, recreating the layout and look of image[1] exactly: a dead-straight one-point-perspective corridor; pale green floor with a pink and gold flower pattern and a coral-red carpet runner down the centre edged with thin green and red stripes; both walls covered by giant ukiyo-e murals of faces and kimono in cream, red and ochre gold; wisteria-purple cloth sashes draped diagonally from the eaves to the floor; rows of crimson paper lanterns under the eaves; a ceiling strung with small colourful ornaments; teal diamond-lattice standing lanterns on purple stands spaced along both sides; the far end glowing with a red and white fan shape as in image[2]. Completely empty, no people. Match the washi texture of image[3]. Palette: image[4].

Same corridor as image[1], same washi paper look, same colours, same standing point in the middle of the corridor at eye level, camera held level. The camera is turned 90 degrees to the LEFT, looking straight at the left wall from about 3 metres away, so the wall fills the frame and runs parallel to the picture plane. The wall is one giant ukiyo-e mural of a woman's face and kimono in cream, red and ochre gold exactly like the left wall of image[1]; a wisteria-purple cloth sash with white flowers drapes diagonally across it from the eaves to the floor; one teal diamond-lattice standing lantern on a purple stand sits at its base; a row of crimson paper lanterns hangs under the eaves at the top; the pale green floor strip and the red edge stripe of the carpet run along the bottom. No people.

Same corridor as image[1], same washi paper look, same colours, same standing point in the middle of the corridor at eye level, camera held level. The camera is turned 90 degrees to the RIGHT, looking straight at the right wall from about 3 metres away, so the wall fills the frame and runs parallel to the picture plane. The wall is one giant ukiyo-e mural of kimono sleeves, fans and butterflies in cream, coral red and ochre gold exactly like the right wall of image[1]; a wisteria-purple cloth sash with white flowers drapes diagonally across it; one teal diamond-lattice standing lantern on a purple stand sits at its base; a row of crimson paper lanterns hangs under the eaves at the top; the pale green floor strip and the red edge stripe of the carpet run along the bottom. Same corridor as image[1], same washi paper look, same colours, same standing point in the middle of the corridor at eye level, camera held level. The camera is turned 180 degrees, looking BACK down the same corridor towards the entrance: identical one-point perspective, same floor with the coral-red carpet runner, same mural walls, purple sashes, crimson lanterns, teal standing lanterns and ornament-strung ceiling, but the far end is a tall closed double door of dark wood with gold fittings framed by two red pillars, instead of the fan. No people.

A seamless 360-degree equirectangular panorama (2:1, full sphere) of the corridor in image[1], taken from one point standing in the exact centre of the corridor at eye level, camera level. Horizontal centre of the panorama = looking down the corridor to the glowing red and white fan at the far end exactly as image[1]. One quarter from the left edge = the left wall, the giant face mural with purple sash and teal standing lantern as image[2], seen from 4 metres away with floor and eaves visible. Three quarters = the right wall, fans and butterflies mural as image[3]. Both outer edges = looking back down the corridor to the tall dark wooden double door as image[4]; the left and right edges must wrap and join perfectly. Top strip = the ceiling strung with small colourful ornaments. Bottom strip = the floor directly underfoot: pale green floor with the coral-red carpet runner passing right under the camera, running front to back. Rows of crimson lanterns under the eaves all around. Empty, no people.

Concept sheet of a temari (Japanese hand-wound thread ball) mononoke, two views side by side on one sheet, same outline style as the character sheet in image[2]. Left: the temari as a plain object, a sphere about 12 cm, wrapped entirely in coloured thread forming geometric temari patterns (chrysanthemum stars, interlocking diamonds, wave bands) in coral red, ochre gold, teal and wisteria purple, one loose thread trailing from it. Right: the same temari as a mononoke, slightly larger, glowing faintly from inside, the threads loosened so that a single pale lavender eye-like mark shows between them, a long coloured thread snaking away along the floor. Plain cream washi paper background, no scene. Palette: image[1].

The temari mononoke in its unravelled form, at night in the corridor of image[4] with the lanterns dimmed. At the centre a half-unwound thread ball with a glowing hollow inside; dozens of coloured threads in coral red, ochre gold, teal and wisteria purple stream out of it in swirling flame-like curls that fill the frame, drawn exactly like the flowing hair in image[3]; the ends of the longest threads become tiny pale lavender hands reaching toward the viewer. No people. Cinematic 2.39:1 composition, outline style of image[2]. Palette: image[1].

Prop design sheet of the Medicine Seller's exorcism sword, same outline style as image[2]. Three views on one sheet, large and horizontal: top, the sword sheathed in its scabbard; middle, the sword drawn beside the empty scabbard; bottom, a close-up of the hilt. The hilt and guard are carved as a stylised human face with closed eyes and a wide grinning mouth, in pale lavender with navy and crimson paint; a short red tassel hangs from the pommel; the scabbard is lacquered navy with ochre-gold and teal hemp-leaf and wave patterns and a wisteria-purple cord. The blade is plain pale steel. Plain cream washi paper background, no hands, no character. Palette: image[1].

Prop design sheet, same outline style as image[2]. Left half: the Medicine Seller's medicine chest exactly as on the back view of image[2], front view and three-quarter view: a tall wooden box with many small drawers, navy and dark brown lacquer, ochre-gold metal fittings and corner guards, a wisteria-purple carrying strap. Right half: the ornate winged balance scale from his waist, front view and side view, large: a teal and ochre-gold butterfly-wing shaped frame with a small round pan hanging under each wing, crimson and navy enamel patterns, a tiny bell. Plain cream washi paper background, no character. Palette: image[1].

Modelling turnaround sheet of the exact same character as image[2], same face, make-up, hat and costume, same colours and patterns. Item icon sheet for a game inventory: exactly 8 square cells in a grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, evenly spaced, each cell framed by a thin dark-indigo line, all cells the same size, filling the whole image edge to edge with equal margins. A seamless 360-degree equirectangular panorama (2:1, full sphere, same format and painted style as image[1] and image[2]) of a small inner courtyard of the inner palace, taken from one point standing in the middle of the courtyard at eye level, camera level, open sky above. scenes._说明: 游5：照积木底稿（kit_build.py -- map_diorama 渲的长卷）重画。七个地点的位置不能挪，网页热区按底稿算（web/src/data/tour/map.json）。长卷比例出不了就分左右两半（接缝在坂井家和笛小路家之间）。需求见 docs/17_总地图重画需求.md
scenes.prompt: A long horizontal emakimono picture scroll, redrawn over the exact composition of image[1]: keep every building, the river, mountains, pines and gold cloud bands at the same position, size and left-to-right order. Style of image[3], colours of image[2], ink outlines thick outside thin inside, asanoha/seigaiha patterns on roofs and drapes, oblique bird's-eye view. Left to right: (1) long palace corridor hall, black tiled roof, crimson pillars, red lanterns under the eaves, wisteria drapes, red gate; (2) three-storey wooden inn on a rainy night, crimson-railed verandas, shoji windows glowing ochre, red lanterns, curved karahafu gable, red arched bridge over the river, slanting rain only here; (3) one-storey samurai house, long black roof, white walls, an old well with a small roof; (4) mansion in near-monochrome ink and pale lavender with a curl of incense smoke; (5) indigo sea patch, merchant ship with one sail, a huge round head with one giant eye rising behind it; (6) Taisho tram car in celadon on rails, row of lit windows; (7) small wooden-barred prison cell with a little roof. Cream paper ground, no people.

scenes._说明: 游5 补丁：只重画总地图长卷左端大奥那一块（20_总地图长卷.png 的 x 0-900、y 300-1100），红鸟居换成宫殿门，出完缩回 900×800 羽化贴回原位（tools/kit_map_patch.py）。热区不动。chat_image 要求边长是 16 的倍数（1800 被拒）
scenes.prompt: Redraw image[1] exactly: same framing, same mountains, gold cloud bands, pine trees, stone embankment, blue river and the edge of the next building on the right, all at the same positions and sizes. Change only one thing: the red torii shrine gate in front of the palace hall is wrong; replace it with an Edo castle inner-palace gate (karamon): a vermilion-lacquered gate with its own small curved black tiled roof and gold fittings, joined on both sides by short roofed corridors hung with wisteria-purple drapes and red paper lanterns, colours like image[2]. Keep the long palace hall behind it, its black tiled roof, red lanterns and purple drapes. Same flat style, same line weight and washi texture as image[1], colours of image[3].

scenes.prompt: A two-panel Japanese folding screen (byobu) seen flat and straight-on, filling the whole frame, a thin dark-wood frame and one vertical gold divider between the two panels. Each panel shows one full-length standing bijin-ga court beauty in ukiyo-e style, head to feet, facing slightly toward each other: elaborate layered kimono with large bold patterns (peony, chrysanthemum, seigaiha waves) in coral, crimson, indigo and ochre, tall black hair with combs and kanzashi, pale face with small red lips. Plain gold-leaf ochre background with a few cream suyari-gasumi cloud bands. Figure drawing and costume detail like image[1], mural flatness and line style like image[2], colours only from image[3]. No text.

scenes.prompt: A coffered Japanese temple ceiling seen from directly below, flat, filling the whole frame: a regular grid of 6 by 5 square panels separated by dark-wood lattice beams with ochre gold fittings at the crossings. Every panel holds one painted rooster or hen in the style of Jakuchu's flock of chickens: bold flat shapes, crimson combs, ochre and navy and cream feathers with crisp patterned scales, each bird in a different pose, on a pale celadon background. Flat cel colours and thin ink outlines like image[1], colours only from image[2]. No text.
